", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u022-r0020", "tag": "p", "text": "“You are marrying me for myself,” she rushed on in triumph.", "sha256": "2498781b8ec88d7f3d9b93f5d49650d13ee58e4a2354c26f90c5b9f073dee0a7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1865]", "source_html": "

“You are marrying me for myself,” she rushed on in triumph.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u022-r0021", "tag": "p", "text": "“For yourself,” Francis could not help but lie.", "sha256": "72f0fb07ace6fd7c65723e6d530151867a415428bb7b5ddfd3a727c9acf6b102", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1866]", "source_html": "

“For yourself,” Francis could not help but lie.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u022-r0022", "tag": "p", "text": "And then he beheld an amazing thing. The Queen, this Queen who was the sheerest autocrat, who said come here and go there, who dismissed the death of Torres with its mere announcement, and who selected her royal spouse without so much as consulting his prenuptial wishes, this Queen began to blush. Up her neck, flooding her face to her ears and forehead, welled the pink tide of maidenly modesty and embarrassment. And such sight of faltering made Francis likewise falter. He knew not what to do, and felt a warmth of blood rising under the sun-tan of his own face. Never, he thought, had there been a man-and-woman situation like it in all the history of men and women. The mutual embarrassment of the pair of them was appalling, and to save his life he could not have summoned a jot of initiative. Thus, the Queen was compelled to speak first.", "sha256": "24a753e03ce648d7a8e53c262a357cafd106e946cc6a85ce0e6d05074cdc83e9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1867]", "source_html": "

And then he beheld an amazing thing. The Queen, this Queen who was the sheerest autocrat, who said come here and go there, who dismissed the death of Torres with its mere announcement, and who selected her royal spouse without so much as consulting his prenuptial wishes, this Queen began to blush. Up her neck, flooding her face to her ears and forehead, welled the pink tide of maidenly modesty and embarrassment. And such sight of faltering made Francis likewise falter. He knew not what to do, and felt a warmth of blood rising under the sun-tan of his own face. Never, he thought, had there been a man-and-woman situation like it in all the history of men and women. The mutual embarrassment of the pair of them was appalling, and to save his life he could not have summoned a jot of initiative. Thus, the Queen was compelled to speak first.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u022-r0023", "tag": "p", "text": "“And now,” she said, blushing still more furiously, “you must make love to me.”", "sha256": "5360913936de5b698c7fe8f191a1cee54cdb760aacfa37338a92daf1da9c8c93", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1868]", "source_html": "

“And now,” she said, blushing still more furiously, “you must make love to me.”

Francis strove to speak, but his lips were so dry that he licked them and succeeded only in stammering incoherently.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u022-r0025", "tag": "p", "text": "“I never have been loved,” the Queen continued bravely. “The affairs of my people are not love. My people are animals without reason. But we, you and I, are man and woman. There must be wooing, and tenderness——that much I have learned from my Mirror of the World. But I am unskilled. I know not how. But you, from out of the great world, must surely know. I wait. You must love me.”", "sha256": "b201317d729cd09e8fc9bf8b767774ddf6727ab1585b9589d4568973d4170c72", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1870]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u022-r0027", "tag": "p", "text": "“Am I not beautiful?” the Queen queried after another pause. “Are not your arms as mad to be about me as I am mad to have them about me? Never have a man’s lips touched my lips. What is a kiss like——on the lips, I mean? Your lips on my hand were ecstasy. You kissed then, not alone my hand, but my soul. My heart was there, throbbing against the press of your lips. Did you not feel it?”", "sha256": "8fe925bb8f03501a5693402dfe11c27b66800cb6ded538b612ca70fc1150895b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1872]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u022-r0028", "tag": "p", "text": "“And so,” she was saying, half an hour later, as they sat on the couch hand in hand, “I have told you the little I know of myself. I do not know the past, except what I have been told of it. The present I see clearly in my Mirror of the World. The future I can likewise see, but vaguely; nor can I always understand what I see. I was born here. So was my mother, and her mother. How it chanced is that always into the life of each queen came a lover. Sometimes, as you, they came here. My mother’s mother, so it was told me, left the valley to find her lover and was gone a long time——for years. So did my mother go forth. The secret way is known to me, where the long dead conquistadores guard the Maya mysteries, and where Da Vasco himself stands whose helmet this Torres animal had the impudence to steal and claim for his own. Had you not come, I should have been compelled to go forth and find you, for you were my appointed one and had to be.”", "sha256": "820a4d14a89ff161ced4ae10fe50fa425c90dfb6d4a415f8366afdb3baf03b7e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1873]", "source_html": "
